title: TATA 1mg - India's Leading Healthcare Platform
text:
BRINGING HIGH QUALITY & RELIABLE DIAGNOSTIC SERVICES TO YOUR DOORSTEP
Diagnostics labs play a crucial role in the accurate diagnosis, treatment, and management of various diseases. To ensure your health and safety, labs follow strict quality standards. Certification and accreditation from recognized organizations demonstrate a lab's commitment to quality and assure its adherence to safety norms and stringent benchmarks.
National Accreditation Board for Testing and Calibration Laboratories (NABL) is a board under Quality Council of India that accredits conformity assessment bodies such as medical testing laboratories for third-party assessment of technical competence.
Accredited diagnostics labs assure that their technical competence in performing various lab tests or health checkups are reliable and they ensure accurate results for quality healthcare.
At Tata 1mg Labs, we adhere to a strict process and follow stringent quality assurance techniques for 100% accurate and reliable reports. We take pride in our rigorous quality control measures that help us maintain high levels of precision.
NETWORK OF TATA 1MG LABS
*View NABL certificates and scope of our Labs
QUALITY HIGHLIGHTS AT TATA 1MG LABS
Accreditation Process
We undergo a thorough third-party assessment by field experts authorized by NABL, who evaluate the lab’s performance and recommend accreditation based on the scope of accreditation we have applied for.
Internal quality control
We follow stringent internal quality control measures that are in accordance with international norms of safety guidelines. These measures are designed to ensure that we maintain high levels of accuracy and reliability in our diagnostic testing services.
Verified test procedures
We use highly validated and standardized test procedures that have been developed and refined over time, following CLSI guidelines. Ensuring precise and accurate results that are critical to effective diagnosis and treatment.

Access medical and health information
Tata 1mg provides you with medical information which is curated, written and verified by experts, accurate and trustworthy. Our experts create high-quality content about medicines, diseases, lab investigations, Over-The-Counter (OTC) health products, Ayurvedic herbs/ingredients, and alternative remedies.
Order medicines online
Get free medicine home delivery in over 1800 cities across India. You can also order Ayurvedic, Homeopathic and other Over-The-Counter (OTC) health products. Your safety is our top priority. All products displayed on Tata 1mg are procured from verified and licensed pharmacies.
Book lab tests
Book any lab tests and preventive health packages from certified labs and get tested from the comfort of your home. Enjoy free home sample collection, view reports online and consult a doctor online for free.
Consult a doctor online
Got a health query? Consult doctors online from the comfort of your home for free. Chat privately with our registered medical specialists to connect directly with verified doctors. Your privacy is guaranteed.
